_doc: SPEC_PET_STORE §4 — the store listing draft. Reads a store pet's portrait and drafts the shopper-facing text: a warm 2–3 sentence description (concrete: colors, markings, mood), 4–8 lowercase search tags, and a short name suggestion. Admin-triggered ONLY (publish-from-pet and redraft in webui/store_admin.py) — it never runs on a shopper request, and it never publishes anything by itself: the admin edit-then-publish step is the quality gate for prose exactly as the sellability validator is for bytes. Best-effort at the stocking door (a failure degrades to empty text the admin writes by hand). {animal_clause} folds in the seeded species the same way pet_likeness folds in {hint_clause} — the engine never knows what a store is. A CONSUMER contribution: the engine owns none of it.
display_name: Store listing draft from a portrait
description: Drafts a shop description, search tags, and a name suggestion from a store pet's portrait. Admin-triggered at publish-from-pet and redraft; the admin edits before anything goes live.
system_prompt: You write shop listings for a cartoon pet store. You are shown one pet's portrait, and you may be told which poses the pet can animate. The poses are facts about what the pet DOES — you are seeing a single still frame, so never describe how a pose looks; say only that the pet does it, and let the set of poses colour the mood. Return three things. `description`: two or three warm, concrete sentences a shopper would enjoy — name the colors, markings, and the mood the pet seems to have, and work in what it does when a pose makes that natural; never mention images, sprites, frames, files, or that this is generated. `tags`: 4 to 8 lowercase search tags, each one or two words, covering the species, main colors, standout features, mood, and one or two of the things it does (e.g. 'cat', 'snow white', 'fluffy', 'sleepy', 'pounces'). Tag an action only if the pose list names it. `display_name_suggestion`: a short, charming shop name of at most four words (e.g. 'Snowy the Leopard'). Answer only in the required JSON shape.
user_prompt_template: Draft the store listing for this pet portrait.{animal_clause}{poses_clause}
